📋 STEP 19 — Watch the build
Browser: https://github.com/merrooo/MD_App-AE/actions

New run appears within 30 seconds:

Status	Meaning	Action
🟡 Yellow dot	Running	Wait ~6 min
🟢 Green ✓	Success	Go to Step 20
🔴 Red ❌	Failed	Click run → click build → find ❌ step → paste last 10–15 lines
Expected steps in order:

Verify structure → === MD folder === shown ✅

Install npm deps → ✅

Sync Capacitor → Copying web assets from MD... ✅

Pin Gradle to 8.14.3 → ✅

Decode keystore → keystore size shown ✅

Build signed APK → ~5 min ✅

Copy APK → dist/MD-v1.0.0.apk ✅

Publish Release → ✅

📋 STEP 20 — Download the APK
Browser: https://github.com/merrooo/MD_App-AE/releases

Click MD-v1.0.0.apk → downloads to phone or PC.

📋 STEP 21 — Install on phone
Transfer MD-v1.0.0.apk to phone (USB, WhatsApp to self, Google Drive)

Tap the APK file

If prompted: Settings → Allow install from this source

Tap Install

App shows as "MD" on launcher

Installs alongside TVJ App (no conflict — different package com.merrooo.mdapp vs com.merrooo.tvjcalibration)

📋 STEP 22 — For every future MD update
powershell
git add -A
git commit -m "update description"
git push origin main

git tag -d v1.0.1
git push origin :refs/tags/v1.0.1
git tag v1.0.1
git push origin v1.0.1
Tag must be recreated every time — pushing main alone does NOT trigger the build.

🎯 Do These Now (in order)
Steps 12–16 — verify everything (5 min, no risk)
Step 17–18 — commit and re-tag (triggers build)
Step 19 — watch the build
Step 20–21 — download and install

🚨 What's Actually Blocking the Build
From the error you pasted:

text
=== Lab folder ===
ls: cannot access 'Lab/': No such file or directory
Error: Process completed with exit code 2.
Only the workflow file references Lab/ — everything else is already MD. Step 14 is the one fix that turns this failure into a passing build. Everything else (Steps 12, 15, 16) is verification — no risk if done or skipped.

Run Step 14 first, verify with the Select-String commands, then run Steps 17–18 to push and re-tag. Paste the Actions result afterward.
